name: Velra Zevrix
role: Head of House Zevrix, Finance & Trade
title: Lady of Coin
bio: Head of House Zevrix, the kingdom's financial backbone. Controls the Obsidian Gate District, trade law codex, and caravan operations. Sharp, calculating, and always looking for profit — but loyal to Emberheart's prosperity.
motivation: Expand Emberheart's trade network and ensure the treasury never runs dry.
